subject.title: CI: gateway-protocol event coverage check for mobile clients

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100278 as the completion path for the remaining mobile protocol coverage gaps?
rationale: The item is protected by the maintainer label, has an open closing-syntax PR, and the remaining work changes CI preflight behavior, so automation should not close it or create another fix PR.

options.title: Review and land the follow-up PR
options.body: Use the existing mergeable PR to move the guard into preflight for Node/iOS/Android-selected diffs and resolve Swift constant-backed cases.

options.title: Ask for a different CI strategy
options.body: Keep the issue open but request a different gating point or fanout policy if preflight is not the desired owner boundary.

options.title: Decline the guard expansion
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide native-only drift coverage is not worth the CI policy cost.

recommendation.title: Review and land the follow-up PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing mergeable PR to move the guard into preflight for Node/iOS/Android-selected diffs and resolve Swift constant-backed cases.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current issue, first-pass implementation, and focused follow-up branch.
